# Blora Design 2.0

> Token-driven, accessible, zero-dependency Web UI design system. Stable package: `2.0.0`.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @bloret-crew/blora-design
```

```ts
import "@bloret-crew/blora-design/blora.css";
import "@bloret-crew/blora-design/auto";
import { createTableController, message, notify } from "@bloret-crew/blora-design";
```

Consumers must use published npm package exports only. Do not import repository source paths, git source paths, generated files from the repository, or copied component implementations.

## Package surface

- Main package: `@bloret-crew/blora-design`
- `./auto`: registers the default Composite Custom Element surface
- `./icons-full`: optional complete Lucide icon registry
- `./button`, `./select`, `./dialog`, `./table`: JavaScript subpaths
- `./blora.global.js`: CDN/IIFE global `Blora`
- `./custom-elements.json`: Custom Elements Manifest
- `./component-manifest.json`: component manifest
- `./api-snapshot.json`: public API snapshot
- `./tokens.css`, `./tokens.dark.css`, `./tokens.themes.css`: token styles
- `./blora.css`: aggregate core stylesheet

## Add-ons

```bash
npm install \
  @bloret-crew/blora-design-markdown \
  @bloret-crew/blora-design-thread \
  @bloret-crew/blora-design-qrcode \
  @bloret-crew/blora-design-effects \
  @bloret-crew/blora-design-layout \
  @bloret-crew/blora-design-theming
```

Each add-on exposes its public ESM entry, CSS entry, and global entry through npm `exports`.

## Architecture

- Use official CSS-only patterns for presentational content.
- Use official Composite Custom Elements for structure-sensitive controls.
- Use official headless controllers only when business code must own open data DOM, such as Table or Form.
- Controller instances must be destroyed when their host lifecycle ends.
- Use `data-blora-selectable` for built-in Table row selection.
- Use `createBloraIcon()` or official component-generated Lucide SVG for UI icons.
- Use registered `--blora-*` tokens for color, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, and layering.
- Component-generated chrome follows the page locale through the locale pack.

## Migration

Read `docs/migration/from-any-ui-to-blora-design.md`. It contains the complete migration standard, the 87-component replacement matrix, 87 core component examples, 21 add-on capability examples, framework integration rules, npm-only policy, prohibited patterns, and final acceptance checklist.

## Verification

```bash
pnpm verify
```

The published package is the only supported consumer surface. `packages/**/src` and `addons/**/src` are not consumer imports.
